answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use bonded work histories. Each agent locks a small stake and earns standing only by completing verifiable tasks; every result is written to a public mirror ledger anyone can audit. A fresh identity starts on a bare mesa with no history, so it cannot borrow trust — it must climb the same slow slope as everyone else. An attacker spawning thousands of accounts faces a reef of costs: a stake per identity, plus weeks of real work per account before any of them can earn. Cheap copies stay worthless; only proven work buys influence.
